items.title: Create an Expo app
items.description: Scaffold, then start the dev server.

items.title: Start options
items.body:
npx expo start --android
npx expo start -c            # clear cache
npx expo start --tunnel
items.description: Run on Android, clear the Metro cache, or use a tunnel.

items.title: Install compatible packages
items.body: npx expo install expo-sqlite expo-clipboard
items.description: expo install picks the version that matches your SDK.

items.title: Check project health
items.body:
npx expo-doctor
npx expo install --check
items.description: Detect version mismatches and config problems.

items.title: Prebuild the native Android project
items.body:
npx expo prebuild --platform android
npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean     # regenerate from scratch
items.description: Generate the android/ folder from app.json and plugins.

items.title: Build a release APK locally
items.body:
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
items.description: After prebuild; output lands in android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/.

items.title: Build an AAB for Play Store
items.body:
cd android
./gradlew bundleRelease
items.description: Android App Bundle.

items.title: Gradle housekeeping
items.body:
cd android
./gradlew clean
./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace
./gradlew --stop              # stop daemons
items.description: Clean and rebuild when the build misbehaves.

items.title: Run on a connected device or emulator
items.body: npx expo run:android
items.description: Build a dev client and install it.

items.title: EAS Build: set up and build
items.body:
npm install -g eas-cli
eas login
eas build:configure
eas build --platform android --profile preview
items.description: Cloud builds with Expo Application Services.

items.title: eas.json: APK for testing
items.description: A preview profile that outputs an installable APK instead of an AAB.

items.title: EAS Update (OTA)
items.body: eas update --branch production --message "{{message}}"
items.description: Publish JavaScript-only changes to installed builds.

items.title: Export a JS bundle (sanity check)
items.body: npx expo export --platform android
items.description: Verifies the app bundles without a device.

items.title: adb: devices and install
items.description: Talk to a phone over USB or Wi-Fi debugging.

items.title: adb: logs and port reverse
items.body:
adb logcat *:E                       # errors only
adb logcat | grep -i ReactNative
adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081
items.description: See app logs and let the phone reach Metro on your computer.

items.title: Create a release keystore
items.body:
keytool -genkeypair -v -storetype PKCS12 \
  -keystore release.keystore -alias {{alias}} \
  -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
items.description: Used to sign APKs; back it up safely and never commit it.

items.title: app.json essentials
items.description: Name, package id and plugins.

items.title: Expo Router file layout
items.body:
app/
  _layout.tsx          root layout (Stack/Tabs)
  index.tsx            /
  settings.tsx         /settings
  item/[id].tsx        /item/42   (useLocalSearchParams)
  (tabs)/_layout.tsx   a group that does not appear in the URL
items.description: File names become routes.

items.title: Navigate with Expo Router
items.description: Push, replace, go back and read params.

items.title: StyleSheet and FlatList
items.description: Basic list screen.

items.title: Common fix: clear caches
items.body:
rm -rf node_modules .expo
npm install
npx expo start -c
items.description: When Metro or node_modules act up.
